items.title: Tabancale language
items.description: Tabancale is an extinct language formerly spoken in the village of Aconipa, located along the Chinchipe River in the Department of Cajamarca, Peru, as well as in neighboring Ecuador, by the Tabancale people. items.title: Miss Universe 2026
items.description: Miss Universe 2026 was the 75th Miss Universe pageant, held at the José Miguel Agrelot Coliseum in San Juan, Puerto Rico, on 24 November 2026. The event was done by R'Bonney Gabriel, Mario Lopez, Zuri Hall, and Dayanara Torres.

items.title: Ezra Frech
items.description: Ezra Frech is an American track and field athlete who competes in high jump, long jump and sprinting events. He is a two-time Paralympian, having competed at the 2020 Summer Paralympics and won two gold medals at the 2024 Summer Paralympics. He also won two silver medals at the 2019 Parapan American Games. items.title: Jennifer Barreto
items.description: Jennifer Barreto is a Puerto Rican model and beauty pageant titleholder who won Miss Universe 2026, becoming the first married woman and mother to win Miss Universe. She is also the second titleholder to win in her own country or territory, after fellow compatriot Miss Universe 2001 Denise Quiñones. She had previously won Miss Universe Puerto Rico 2026.
